description: This pie chart illustrates four distinct components or features, likely representing the core dimensions of the benchmark referenced in the associated paper. The chart is divided into four equal slices, each accounting for approximately 25% of the total area. The top-left slice is colored yellow-orange and contains the bolded label "Complexity" alongside a ladder icon; it is accompanied by an external text box with a matching yellow border containing blurred text. The top-right slice is light blue, labeled "Instance" with a shield icon, and is paired with an external blue-bordered box reading "Unhackable". The bottom-right slice is green, labeled "Coverage" with a globe and gear icon, and has an adjacent green-bordered box labeled "General". The bottom-left slice is red, labeled "Scalable Oversight" with a clipboard icon, and is associated with a red-bordered box reading "Auto-verifiable". The chart does not include a traditional legend or explicit numerical percentage labels. Instead, the slices are visually emphasized by being slightly offset or exploded from the center, separated by intersecting white space. Because all four segments are visually equal in size, there is no descending or ascending order based on proportion.
